messages.subject: Shiny/ Leaflet - Superzip not clickable
parts:
Hey everybody,

I have been playing around with Joe Cheng's superzip application (https://github.com/jcheng5/superzip/), trying to adopt it to a different context.

However, I ran in to trouble as I can not get the clicking on observations to work.

Everything else seems to work fine, I guess there may be some hidden dependency that is not loaded / that I am not aware of?

Did anybody experience similar problems? I appreciate your thoughts,

best Thiemo
